title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
steps: Beat eggs and mix with parmesan.
Combine spaghetti, bacon, and egg mixture.
Season with black pepper and serve.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken cooked in creamy tomato sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 1 hour.
Prepare sauce with tomato puree and cream.
Add grilled chicken to sauce and simmer 10 min.
